skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

llm.summary: This is a local Chinese enterprise income tax table checker that reads user-supplied input and prints deterministic results without hidden network, persistence, or account access.

dimensions.detail: Allowed Read and Bash fit the documented workflow: run a local script and read a user-selected input file. The code uses Node standard-library file reads and console output only.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, remote retrieval, dependency setup, or post-install behavior was found; usage invokes the bundled Node script directly.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are mostly Chinese and aimed at a Chinese tax workflow, which is coherent with the skill purpose; users should understand that outputs are not a tax-law opinion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, credential access, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory changes, privilege escalation, or network calls were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is to check 企业所得税纳税调整表 arithmetic and consistency; the scripts implement that narrow parser/checker and expose the withheld checks instead of silently executing broader behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are working with Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables and are comfortable running a local Node script on files you choose. Treat “NO_ISSUE_FOUND” as limited to the free arithmetic/consistency checks; it does not validate tax-law basis, eligibility, withheld paid checks, or official filing correctness.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file was present and fully inspected; it is a local CLI wrapper around the bundled engine, so the scanner coverage concern is resolved by artifact inspection.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-only user-facing text is coherent for a Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment-table checker and is disclosed in the manifest, so this is a locale/usability note rather than a security concern.
[SDI-1] expected: The output includes reference rate fields and a disclaimer, but it also explicitly lists CHECKS_WITHHELD and checks_not_run; this could still confuse users, but it is disclosed rather than hidden.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The comment mentioning contract text is inconsistent with the tax-table purpose, but runtime behavior and user-facing usage still require tax-adjustment table input; this is a documentation cleanup issue.
